DEXJPUS.description: Japanese yen to one U.S. dollar, H.10 noon buying rate in New York, daily, not seasonally adjusted (Board of Governors via FRED)
DEXJPUS.raw_note: raw file contains rows after 2014-12-31; lane code never reads it (reads only the cut file)
DEXJPUS.missing_value_note: empty value on NY holidays (no noon rate); dropped, forward-filled onto trading calendars
DEXJPUS.revisions: market rate, not revised; no vintage needed
DEXJPUS.pit_rule: value dated d usable from the first trading day after d (d+1 calendar day, then ffill)
